Verified by web search before writing: Reg T payment period is two business days beyond standard settlement (T+3 under T+1 settlement), the de minimis unpaid amount is $1,000 measured in aggregate rather than per trade, extensions come from the firm's DEA via REX and not the SEC, and the freeze is 90 days; a purchased call counts as a substantially identical security under Section 1091 so it triggers a wash sale, with the disallowed loss added to the replacement basis (and forfeited outright, per Rev. Rul. 2008-5, if the replacement sits in an IRA); 1035 runs one way only, life into annuity but never annuity into life, basis carries over while the surrender-charge clock does not; FINRA simplified arbitration is $50,000 or less with one arbitrator on the papers, one arbitrator through $100,000 absent written agreement for three, three above that, and the eligibility rule is six years. Single send, no duplicate this run.
